info.name: Movie Ticket Booking System
info.description: Run folders 1 -> 4 in order (Collection Runner works). Set adminPassword to the ADMIN_PASSWORD you used when starting the app.

exec: pm.test('201 created OR 409 if already registered', function () { pm.expect([201, 409]).to.include(pm.response.code); });

request.description: Uses ADMIN_EMAIL / ADMIN_PASSWORD you set before starting the app. Put the same password into the collection variable adminPassword.

exec: const d = new Date(Date.now() + 2 * 24 * 3600 * 1000); const p = n => String(n).padStart(2, '0');
pm.collectionVariables.set('showTime', d.getFullYear() + '-' + p(d.getMonth() + 1) + '-' + p(d.getDate()) + 'T' + p(d.getHours()) + ':' + p(d.getMinutes()) + ':00');
for (let i = 0; i < 6; i++) { pm.collectionVariables.set('seatId' + (i + 1), s[i].id); }
pm.test('all seats start AVAILABLE', function () { pm.expect(s.every(x => x.status === 'AVAILABLE')).to.be.true; });
